panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 6 panels (A, B, C, D, E, F). A: Skull radiograph from a 3-month-old with captioned facial bone sclerosis in a craniometaphyseal dysplasia case. B: Forearm radiograph showing captioned metaphyseal widening/flaring in a craniometaphyseal dysplasia case. C: Femur radiograph showing captioned long-bone metaphyseal widening/flaring in a craniometaphyseal dysplasia case. D: Tibia/fibula radiograph showing captioned metaphyseal widening/flaring in a craniometaphyseal dysplasia case. E: Chest/rib radiograph showing captioned cupping at rib ends, described as an early rachitic-like feature in this craniometaphyseal dysplasia case. F: Spine/rib survey radiograph from the same infant; no specific CMD vocabulary finding is captioned for this panel, so attribution is weaker.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Axial cranial CT of the index patient described in an article on craniometaphyseal dysplasia; caption states CT revealed fusion of the coronal sutures. The manifestation is not covered by the supplied vocabulary, so it is recorded as a proposed finding; no explicit cranial hyperostosis is stated in the caption, so no vocabulary key was assigned. B: Sagittal MRI of the same patient with a white arrow marking Chiari malformation type 1, as stated in the caption of this craniometaphyseal dysplasia case report. Chiari malformation is not in the allowed vocabulary, so it is listed under proposed_findings; attribution rests on the disease-focused article title together with the specific captioned finding.
